top_papers.abstract: Inference-time scaling improves the performance of large language models by sampling multiple responses and evaluating their collective utility. top_papers.abstract: Generative recommendation benefits from long interaction histories, but the cost of processing them directly grows with history length. We propose RecMem, a recurrent memory compression framework guided by three desiderata: space invariance, semantic fidelity, and lifelong evolvability.
